title: Shopfi tenant onboarding API (PROV-03)
description: Request and response bodies of /api/v1/platform/onboarding/*. Every response body is the CustomApiResponse envelope {description, data}. Validated against the documented examples by OnboardingContractTest. Server-side rules that JSON Schema cannot express (reserved slugs beyond the listed ones, e-mail deliverability, byte length of the password) are documented in onboarding.md.

Slug.description: Tenant slug. The server trims and lowercases first; this schema describes the normalised form. 3-40 chars, lowercase letters and digits, single hyphens between them only.

Email.description: Shape check only (one @, no whitespace). The server uses Jakarta @Email and normalises case; deliverability is not checked.

password.description: Trimmed by the server. At least 8 characters; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes (BCrypt limit, so 72 is only exact for ASCII). The API accepts up to 200 characters at the bean-validation layer and then rejects over-72-byte values with 400.

plan.description: Optional, defaults to FREE. Records intent only; no billing.

OnboardingStatus.description: data of signup, verify and status responses. storefrontUrl and adminLoginUrl are present only when status is ACTIVE and tenant.base-domain is configured; they are omitted (not null) otherwise.

StatusEnvelope.description: Success envelope for signup (201), verify (202) and status (200).

ResendEnvelope.description: Resend always answers 202 with this exact body, whatever happened.

description.const: If a pending signup matches, a new verification code has been sent

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every non-2xx body. description is human readable and NOT a stable machine code; branch on the HTTP status. data is null, except for bean-validation failures (400) where it maps field name to message.
